name: eyay-toolkits
description: Personal omp plugins and pi packages. Built for shipping systems, not essays. If it helps you, steal it.

plugins.name: design-thinking
plugins.description: Design Thinking · Design Graph · Graph Protocol — a stack-agnostic design methodology for omp. Draws a Design Graph (call graph, named failure paths) before writing code, review, or refactor. Includes the /cg, /cg-plan, /cg-review, /cg-map prompt family.

contributors.name: r17x
contributors.note: Original Design Thinking concepts and methodology

plugins.name: block-forbidden-git-add
plugins.description: Extension that denies whole-tree git add, protected-path staging (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, docs/, secrets/), and history-rewriting git commands before the Bash tool runs.

plugins.name: iac-check-guard
plugins.description: Extension that blocks IaC write/destructive commands (ansible-playbook/ansible-pull without --check, ad-hoc ansible write modules, terragrunt/tofu/terraform apply-family including mise-wrapped forms) before the Bash tool runs.

plugins.name: agent-notify
plugins.description: Extension that fires terminal-native banners (OSC 777/9/99, notify-send, Windows toast) when the agent finishes, needs an approval, or is retrying, so you can leave the terminal.

plugins.name: exit-commands
plugins.description: Adds vim muscle-memory quit input aliases to the omp/pi REPL: `:q` (plus `:q!`, `:wq`, `:wq!`, `:x`, `:xq`) and a `/exit` command, all via graceful shutdown. `/quit` is built-in; `/exit` is not.

plugins.name: general-reminder
plugins.description: Configurable standing reminders: reads <project>/.omp/reminders.json (or .pi/ on pi) and injects its contents into every run — always-on entries plus optional one-shot notes per session.
